firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure prioritizes authorization independence and data clarity. The core design revolves around user-owned data and leverages path-based ownership for maximum security and efficient querying. The `users/{userId}` collection stores user profile data. The `stations` collection holds information about each station in the EcoQuest Explorers game. The relationship between users and stations is tracked via the `users/{userId}/stationProgress/{stationProgressId}` subcollection to record individual progress through each station. Finally, the `users/{userId}/stationProgress/{stationProgressId}/contentSubmissions/{contentSubmissionId}` models the user generated content submissions for each station. This design achieves Authorization Independence by associating all station progress and content submission directly to a user id. This means that all station progress and content submissions are dependent on a user document in order to be created. This design is also favorable since the app has a 1:N relationship from User to Station Progress to Content Submission.
